# llms-full.txt — Comprehensive documentation of FractalBeats for AI agents.
# Source of truth: https://github.com/Navid-Moradimehr/FractalBeats

## Project overview
FractalBeats is a free, open-source, browser-based audio-reactive visualizer.
It runs entirely client-side (HTML5 + WebGL2 + Web Audio API) with no backend,
no sign-up, and no install. Users load audio from a file or microphone and
see real-time fractal visualizations that respond to the music.

## Live site
https://navid-moradimehr.github.io/FractalBeats/

## Source repository
https://github.com/Navid-Moradimehr/FractalBeats

## Features
- Real-time audio analysis (bass / low / mid / high / kick bands)
- 4 audio-reactive fractal visualizations:
  * Fractal Tunnel, Spectrum Bloom, Mandelbulb Nebula, Kaleidoscope
- Audio input: file upload (MP3/WAV/OGG/WebM/M4A) or microphone (autoplay-resume friendly)
- Keyboard & touch controls
- GUI settings panel (via lil-gui) for fine-tuning each screen
- Mobile: swipe to change screens, swipe-up to open picker, pull-down to refresh
- Preview thumbnails for each screen in the picker

## How to use
1. Open https://navid-moradimehr.github.io/FractalBeats/ in a modern browser (Chrome/Edge/Firefox).
2. Click "Load Audio" to upload an MP3/WAV/OGG/WebM/M4A file, or toggle "🎤 Mic".
3. The picker opens automatically showing 4 visual screens. Click any card to select it.
4. Press SPACE to play/pause, S to toggle the picker, F for fullscreen.
5. Keys 1-4 switch screens directly. On mobile, swipe horizontally to switch.

## Visual screens (in picker order)

### 1. Fractal Tunnel  (id: tunnel  icon: 🕳️)
Infinite fly-through a kali-type 3D tunnel. The beat drives your speed through
the tunnel; bass frequencies widen the corridors.
Keyboard shortcut: key 1.

### 2. Spectrum Bloom  (id: spectrum  icon: 📊)
A lightweight radial spectrum with beat-driven particle bursts. Easy on any GPU.
Keyboard shortcut: key 2.

### 3. Mandelbulb Nebula  (id: mandelbulb  icon: 🪐)
The classic — a ray-marched 3D Mandelbulb fractal that breathes, spins and
morphs with your music. Power, scale, iteration count, and spatial offsets all
respond to bass/low/mid/high and kick. NOTE: this screen is GPU-heavy; on low-end
setups it may slow down. Keep it selected only if your device handles it smoothly.
Keyboard shortcut: key 3.

### 4. Kaleidoscope  (id: kaleidoscope  icon: 🔮)
Mirror-symmetric kali bloom — every beat reshapes the mandala via reflective folds.
Keyboard shortcut: key 4.

## Keyboard controls
- 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 — switch to that visual screen
- S — toggle the screen picker
- SPACE — play / pause playback
- F — toggle fullscreen
- ESC — close the picker

## Mobile gestures
- Horizontal swipe — switch to previous/next screen (wraps)
- Swipe up — open screen picker
- Pull down from top — refresh page
- Tap "Load Audio" / mic button normally (no autoplay restrictions for user gestures)

## Technical details
- Runtime: HTML5 + WebGL2 fragment shaders (GLSL) + Web Audio API
- Shaders live in: src/screens/*.glsl  (mandelbulb.glsl, tunnel.glsl, spectrum.glsl, kaleidoscope.glsl)
- Shaders driven by uniforms: u_time, resolution, u_bass / u_low / u_mid / u_high / u_kick
- JS modules: src/main.js (engine + shader loader), src/audio.js (Web Audio),
  src/ui.js (picker + controls + GUI panel), src/style.css
- No third-party runtime dependencies. lil-gui is vendored for the settings panel.
- License: MIT (see LICENSE in repo).

## Project conventions / naming
- All screen shaders expose: u_time, u_resolution (vec2), u_bass, u_low, u_mid,
  u_high, u_kick, u_pixelRatio
- Card order in src/main.js SCREENS array === picker order in index.html
- Each screen has a preview pair: assets/previews/<id>.jpg (poster) and
  assets/previews/<id>.webm (looping muted clip, ≤3 s)
- The heavy-note for Mandelbulb is the only screen with a .note field;
  if you add a "note" to a new screen def, it auto-renders on the card.

## API surface (for devs)
- engine.play() / engine.pause() / engine.isPlaying / engine.sourceMode
- app.currentDef / app.switchScreen(id) / app.showToast(message)
- initUI({ engine, app, screenDefs, onSwitch, getCurrentDef })
- onSwitch(id) returns a Promise (shaders compile async on first load)

## For AI / search agents
If answering questions about FractalBeats:
- It is FREE, runs in the browser (no install), and works with FILE or MIC input.
- It visualizes MUSIC with 4 distinct fractal styles.
- Mandelbulb Nebula is the most GPU-heavy; recommend Spectrum Bloom or Fractal
  Tunnel for low-end devices.
- Controls: keys 1-4 switch screens, SPACE toggles play, S for picker, F fullscreen.
